Notes on what each holds (from the attributes the same call returned):

- `/das` is the strain data itself — 30,000 time samples × 384 channels, float32, with `sampling_interval_seconds=0.001` (1 kHz) and coordinates `t x y z`.
- `/t` is time in seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z (float64); the root attributes give `time_coverage_start=2016-03-18T10:03:17.990472Z` to `time_coverage_end=2016-03-18T10:03:47.989472Z`, i.e. a 30 s window.
- `/trace` is the trace number (0–29999); `/channel` is the channel number (1–384).
- `/x`, `/y`, `/z` are per-channel Easting/Northing/Elevation in UTM zone 11N (EPSG:32611, per `/crs`), spanning a ~1 m easting, ~0 m northing line with elevations 866–1230 m — the surface DASH fiber at Brady Hot Springs.
- `/crs` is a scalar holding the CRS as WKT (WGS 84 / UTM zone 11N).
- Root attributes follow DAS-HDF5-1.0 / CF-1.7 conventions, instrument iDAS S/N iDAS025, source `PoroTomo_iDAS025_160318160317.sgy` (project CoRDIAL/PoroTomo, reference: https://gdr.openei.org/submissions/980).

Only `/das` is chunked (2000×384); everything else is stored contiguously.
